mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_skill_def (id, version, name, description, purpose, usage, content, declared_tools, declared_mcp, risk_ceiling, param_policies, required_caps, namespace, config_fingerprint, schema_version, created_at, updated_at, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{version}, #{name}, #{description}, #{purpose}, #{usage}::jsonb, #{content}::text, #{declaredTools}::jsonb, #{declaredMcp}::jsonb, #{riskCeiling}, #{paramPolicies}::jsonb, #{requiredCaps}::jsonb, 'platform', #{configFingerprint}, #{schemaVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{publishedAt}) ON CONFLICT (id, version) DO NOTHING
